title: AGI Visionaries — The People With Coherent Visions

sam_altman.name: Sam Altman
sam_altman.vision: AGI is imminent. We know how to build it. Safety through deployment.
key_quotes: We are now confident we know how to build AGI as we have traditionally understood it.
Post-AGI, no one is going to work and the economy is going to collapse.
I am switching to polyphasic sleep because GPT-5.5 in Codex is so good.
sam_altman.approach: Build fast, deploy, iterate. Safety through scale and oversight.
sam_altman.episode_hook: The man who says he knows how to build God, and is losing sleep over it.

elon_musk.name: Elon Musk
elon_musk.vision: AGI is the biggest risk humanity faces. Build it carefully, or don't build it at all.
key_quotes: AGI is significantly higher risk than nuclear weapons.
I think it's not unreasonable to feel that we are now in the AGI era.
elon_musk.approach: Build Grok to AGI, but warn about the dangers. Open source as safety.
elon_musk.episode_hook: The man who builds rockets and warns about AI. Both are about escaping Earth.

demis_hassabis.name: Demis Hassabis
demis_hassabis.vision: AGI will solve science. But we need a 'precious window' to prepare.
key_quotes: AGI is probably only a few short years away.
What we collectively do now will determine how the next phase of civilisation unfolds.
I call myself a cautious optimist.
demis_hassabis.approach: Solve intelligence, then solve science. Nobel Prize for protein folding.
demis_hassabis.risk_view: Cautious. Precious window to prepare. Not enough is being done.
demis_hassabis.episode_hook: The gamer who became a scientist who's building God. And he's worried.

dario_amodei.name: Dario Amodei
dario_amodei.vision: Safety first. AGI is coming, but we need to get alignment right.
key_quotes: Half of entry-level white-collar work could vanish in the next half-decade.
There is a 'precious window' to act before AGI arrives.
dario_amodei.approach: Constitutional AI. Safety through structure, not just scale.
dario_amodei.risk_view: High. Alignment is the hard problem.
dario_amodei.episode_hook: The man who quit OpenAI to build AI safely. Now he's racing the clock.

jensen_huang.name: Jensen Huang
jensen_huang.vision: AGI is here. But the term is meaningless. Focus on impact, not labels.
key_quotes: I think it's now. I think we've achieved AGI.
The term AGI has become so overused and ill-defined that it has lost its meaning.
jensen_huang.approach: Build the hardware. Let others worry about the definition.
jensen_huang.risk_view: Dismissive. Focus on practical value, not existential risk.
jensen_huang.episode_hook: The man who sells shovels in the gold rush, and says the gold is already here.

ben_goertzel.name: Ben Goertzel
ben_goertzel.vision: AGI within 9-12 months. Decentralized AI. Open source.
key_quotes: Does that really mean AGI can happen in the next year? We can't say for sure.
But it increased my probability weight.
ben_goertzel.approach: Open source AGI. Decentralized. No single point of control.
ben_goertzel.risk_view: Moderate. Decentralization is the safety mechanism.
ben_goertzel.episode_hook: The man who wants to build AGI and give it away for free.

gary_marcus.name: Gary Marcus
gary_marcus.vision: AGI is much harder than we think. LLMs are not enough.
key_quotes: AGI is a shorthand for any intelligence that is flexible and general.
Today's systems are impressive but not intelligent.
gary_marcus.approach: Skeptic. Push back on hype. Demand real benchmarks.
gary_marcus.risk_view: The real risk is overconfidence, not the technology itself.
gary_marcus.episode_hook: The man who says everyone else is wrong. And he might be right.

nick_bostrom.name: Nick Bostrom
nick_bostrom.vision: Superintelligence is the last invention. The control problem is unsolved.
key_quotes: The fate of our species would come to depend on the actions of the machine superintelligence.
We get to make the first move.
nick_bostrom.approach: Philosophical. Think about the worst case. Design for it.
nick_bostrom.risk_view: Existential. The gorilla analogy. We are the gorillas.
nick_bostrom.episode_hook: The philosopher who wrote the book that scared Silicon Valley.
